info.title: ProyekKas API v1
info.description: Versioned contract for the Android APK and admin custom views (architecture §6). Errors: RFC 9457.

bearer.description: Keycloak access token of client proyekkas-mobile (realm drms). Requires header X-Device-Id of a registered active device.

MasterItem.description: Whitelisted fields per type (id, updatedAt, active, …)

deviceId.description: Install id generated by the APK (UUID); must equal X-Device-Id.

jobId.description: payload_jobs id of the sendEmail job (sent by the worker)

accountNo.description: Masked (last 4) unless own request or Finance/Owner/Admin.

budget.description: US-26 preview (committed % before → after); cost centers: "none" (Q-24).

allowedActions.description: UI hint; the server re-checks every action.

receiptsTotal.description: Σ active receipts at the last LPJ submit.

difference.description: transferred − receipts (verified after verification): > 0 refund, < 0 shortfall.

Settlement.description: T5 LPJ (Uang Muka only; null before "Nota Lengkap").

requesterIds.description: "Diajukan Oleh" in order (default: the caller's employee).

bankAccountId.description: employee-bank-accounts id of one of the requesters (Q-11).

clientUuid.description: APK offline id; a retry with the same value returns the existing draft.

id.description: Existing line id (keep to update a line in place; omit for new lines).

unitPrice.description: Informational only — never used to compute the total (Q-05).

total.description: PRIMARY value entered by the user (may be rounded from the receipt).

requesterIds.description: "Diajukan Oleh" in order (default: the caller's employee).

bankAccountId.description: employee-bank-accounts id of one of the requesters (Q-11).

ExpenseRequestUpdate.description: Draft only. Omitted fields stay unchanged; `lines` replaces all lines.

docType.description: expense_request, or a satellite: receipt, transfer, settlement, cash_entry.

signatureMediaId.description: media-signatures id captured on screen (own upload); default = profile signature.

imageId.description: media-receipts id uploaded by the caller (POST /media/receipts).

amount.description: Optional echo; must equal the approved amount (Finance cannot change it, G3).

CashEntryUpdate.description: Manual entries of an open period only; amount/date/account changes = void + new entry.

usageNotes.description: Required at the first submit; kept on resubmit when omitted.

date.description: KM date (refund) or transfer date (shortfall); default today.

proofMediaId.description: Shortfall: media-transfer-proofs id (required). Refund: media-attachments id (optional).

amount.description: Optional echo; must equal the server-computed |difference|.

scope.description: Project or cost center code + name.
